    How to make a mandala sticker

    1. Pick a design. Start from one of the starting designs, press Surprise me, or draw your own.
    2. Choose a look. Under Make it yours, keep your own colors or pick Night glow for gold lines on a dark disc.
    3. Set the size. Enter the size across the cut line, 3 inches to start, and the width of the white border. The note under the design tells you how wide the thinnest lines print at that size.
    4. Download. The sticker SVG for print then cut, or the sticker PNG for online sticker printers.

    Which file to use

    FileBest for
    Sticker SVGPrint-and-cut printers and print shops, or any workflow that reads a CutContour line. White bleed runs past the cut, so a cut that lands slightly off never shows a hard edge.
    Sticker PNGOnline sticker printers and Cricut Print Then Cut, which trace the edge of the image. 300 dpi, transparent outside the white border.
    Disc onlyRound labels and printers that cut their own circle: tick Disc only for the design on its disc, with no border, bleed or cut line.

    Tips for small stickers

    • Lines. The sticker file never draws a line thinner than 0.12 mm, so fine detail still prints. For stickers under 2 inches, a Line weight of 4 or more keeps them crisp.
    • Words. On a 3 inch sticker, aim for an opening of an inch or more for a name. The maker shows it as you slide Opening.
    • Colors. Set the line and background colors under Make it yours. Night glow turns dark lines gold on a deep indigo disc, with a soft glow behind the center.

    Questions

    Is the sticker maker free? Can I sell the stickers?

    Yes. Every sticker download is free, with no watermark, and you may sell the stickers you make.

    What is the CutContour layer?

    CutContour is the name print-and-cut software and many print shops look for to find the cut line. The sticker SVG puts the cut line, a thin magenta circle, on a layer of its own with that name, and everything that prints in a group called artwork.

    What size should a sticker be?

    Round stickers are most often 2 to 4 inches across. The maker starts at 3 inches, measured across the cut line, with a 0.1 inch white border. Enter any size in inches or millimeters.

    Will it work with Cricut Print Then Cut?

    Yes. Upload the sticker PNG to Design Space as a Print Then Cut image, and Cricut cuts around the edge of the white border. Check the size in Design Space before you print.

    Can I put a name on a sticker?

    Yes. Start from the name mandala, or from one of the mandala frames for words and switch Making to Sticker. Type a name or a date under Make it yours, and the maker shows how wide the opening is on your sticker.
